_README: This file records selected public product descriptions and their limits; it is not an exhaustive market census.
Presence of a feature is prior art. A vendor claim is not an independent causal result.
A search that did not find a deployment is not proof that no deployment exists.
Do not claim that the mechanisms below are new or that no provider has run a randomized trial.

capabilities_described_in_reviewed_sourc.capability: COD payment and dynamic UPI QR
capabilities_described_in_reviewed_sourc.scope: These sources describe existing payment-on-delivery or QR capabilities.
capabilities_described_in_reviewed_sourc.proposal_implication: Do not present doorstep QR as novel; treat payment-provider compatibility as an implementation question.

capabilities_described_in_reviewed_sourc.capability: NDR, customer messaging, and delivery recovery workflows
capabilities_described_in_reviewed_sourc.scope: Provider materials show that notifications and recovery tools exist as product categories.
capabilities_described_in_reviewed_sourc.proposal_implication: The deck should differentiate through a feasible, measured decision process rather than claim a new message or NDR feature.

capabilities_described_in_reviewed_sourc.scope: Global postal-operator analysis; not an Indian marketplace or Valmo experiment.
capabilities_described_in_reviewed_sourc.proposal_implication: Use only as external context; validate any optional customer prompt locally.

category_warning.interpretation: Vendor category of fake or fraudulent orders; not a false rider-attempt-status event rate.

claims_not_supported_by_this_scan: A complete ranking or census of every provider's features.
That no market participant has run a randomized delivery experiment.
That any provider's claimed percentage reduction will transfer to Valmo.
That a specific Valmo integration, policy, or seller permission currently exists.
That survey-reported rider attributions represent customer motives or order causes.
That a novel algorithm or intervention has been validated by repository simulations.
defensible_submission_position: Existing tools provide prior art. The proposal asks for governed baseline data, audited reasons, a spillover-aware controlled test, full-cost economics, and explicit customer, rider, seller, service, and privacy guardrails. It makes no claim that this method is unprecedented.
